definitions.explanation: Costing less than expected or less than alternatives. Emphasizes the result of something turning out to be affordable or low-cost.

examples.japanese: {自炊|じすい}は{安上|やすあ}がりだ。
{安上|やすあ}がりな{旅行|りょこう}プランを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for an economical travel plan.

examples.japanese: {手作|てづく}りすれば、{買|か}うより{安上|やすあ}がりに{済|す}む。
examples.english: If you make it by hand, it turns out cheaper than buying it.

notes:
Describes something that turns out to be inexpensive — emphasizes the result being cheap rather than the initial cost.

FORMS:
{安|やす}い (cheap) + {上|あ}がり (result/outcome). Literally "cheap outcome."
- Na-adjective: {安上|やすあ}がりな{旅行|りょこう} (an economical trip)
- Predicate: {自炊|じすい}は{安上|やすあ}がりだ (cooking for yourself is cheap)
- Adverb: {安上|やすあ}がりに{済|す}む (to get off cheaply)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜より{安上|やすあ}がり: cheaper than ~
- {安上|やすあ}がりに{済|す}む: to turn out cheap
- {安上|やすあ}がりに{仕上|しあ}がる: to end up being inexpensive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {安|やす}い: cheap (simple, direct)
- {経済的|けいざいてき}: economical (more formal)
- お{得|とく}: good value, a bargain
